🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
Sector Rotation, not Risk-Off. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -0.01% | 1M: -19.83%) and XLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +9.19%) signal fear easing and cyclical leadership while HYG (1W: +0.15% | 1M: +1.14%) / LQD CORRECTION (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.65%) indicate rising credit stress.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress tick-up: HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.15% | 1M: +1.14%) vs LQD CORRECTION (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.65%) — mixed credit signal. Fear easing: VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -0.01% | 1M: -19.83%). Stocks vs bonds showing exhaustion: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.85% | 1M: +2.01%) and TLT RECOVERY (1W: +0.93% | 1M: -0.46%).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-cautionary: Dollar showing POTENTIAL REVERSAL (1W: +0.15% | 1M: -1.40%) and yield curve slight steepening (Yield Curve ↑ rising on 1W). Overall conditions patchy with bond and credit signals mixed.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals showing relative strength: XLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +9.19%) and XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +5.40%), while Tech is lagging: XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -1.72% | 1M: +0.52%). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow breadth.

5. US vs Global?
US equities in CORRECTION: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.85% | 1M: +2.01%) and QQQ CORRECTION (1W: -0.78% | 1M: +1.49%). Europe showing strength: VGK ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.48% | 1M: +5.20%). China weak: FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -0.96% | 1M: -1.03%).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative flows cooling: IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -5.16% | 1M: -4.28%), ARKK CORRECTION (1W: -1.63% | 1M: +6.30%), IWM CORRECTION (1W: -1.67% | 1M: +6.93%).

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Precious metals leadership: SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +26.95%) and GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.60% | 1M: +6.09%); copper strength via CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.69%).

8. Energy Trend?
Energy weak across the board: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.08% | 1M: -1.85%), BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -1.81% | 1M: -4.58%) and UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -15.58%).

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Cyclical skew — XLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +9.19%) and CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.69%). DIVERGENCE: MAJOR divergence present — SPY CORRECTION, XLK CORRECTION and XLF CORRECTION (each 1W down / 1M up) reduces conviction and supports a Transitional/Rotation stance.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals showing strength (XLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +9.19%), XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +5.40%)), reduce exposure to high-volatility/speculative ETFs (IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -5.16% | 1M: -4.28%), ARKK CORRECTION (1W: -1.63% | 1M: +6.30%)), and monitor credit spreads closely.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +9.19%), XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +5.40%). BEARISH: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.08% | 1M: -1.85%), XLK CORRECTION (1W: -1.72% | 1M: +0.52%).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +26.95%), CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.69%). BEARISH: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -15.58%), BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -1.81% | 1M: -4.58%).

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD watch level ~0.80 for credit health, XLK/XLF ratio ~2.6 (tech vs financials pivot), SPY support cluster near short-term 1W lows.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Rotation, not a clean Risk-Off; Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Cyclicals and precious metals showing strength (XLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +9.19%), SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +26.95%)). Key risk is a MAJOR divergence across core ETFs (SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.85% | 1M: +2.01%), XLK CORRECTION (1W: -1.72% | 1M: +0.52%), XLF CORRECTION (1W: -0.95% | 1M: +5.57%)) and rising credit stress to monitor.
